key_insight: BLIP-Live frames proactive video understanding as deciding when enough evidence has arrived to respond. It aims to balance timely answers with precise response triggering, avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect outputs.
problem_solved: Streaming video agents must decide not only what to say, but when to say it—without relying on future frames or interrupting unnecessarily.
method: Define proactivity as causal response decisions based on video evidence available so far.
Unify data, evaluation metrics, an evaluation harness, and training around this shared decision framework.
Assess the trade-off between responding promptly and triggering responses appropriately.
impact: BLIP-Live offers practitioners a unified framework for developing and evaluating agents that respond at useful moments during live video. The provided abstract is truncated and does not report quantitative results.
visual_elements: Video timeline showing evidence accumulation and the moment an agent responds.
Trade-off chart with response delay and firing precision as axes, without invented numerical results.
Framework diagram connecting data, metrics, evaluation harness, and training.
Side-by-side examples of premature, redundant, and appropriately timed responses.
paper_title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
paper_authors: Kanchana Ranasinghe, Honglu Zhou, Dominick Reilly, Le Xue, Shusheng Yang
